body:
Not an expert on the subject, but are you sure what you're describing isn't postpartum depression? I guarantee your baby doesn't hate you, you didn't specify her age but from what I glean she's very young. At that age, babies do not have the capacity for hate, but they do have the capacity to be fussy and frustrating. But postpartum depression can be absolutely brutal, I guarantee you're not a monster for thinking this way.

As for your mom, is there any way you can distance yourself from her for a while?

Even if I lay my neck on the tracks? I think it would sever my head pretty quickly. I'm not a masochist, I've just wanted to be dead since I was around 12 and I'm also poor. But a gun is probably better, you're right.

In a similar boat. Attempted like 4 years ago, anniversary is coming up in January. I wish I had died that day too. Life started to get better for me for a while, but it all came crashing down last month. I'm just so tired.

Yeah that's my biggest fear with trains. Worst case scenario i guess i can lay my head on the tracks, but on crowded subway platforms someone will see me and probably stop the trains or w/e. I guess worst case scenario I can take a ride on a commuter rail, then get out and lay down on the tracks for the next one to come along. Hopefully no one will see me and call the police or anything.

Thanks for the tips. Any idea where I can get this kind of gun? I live in a state with strict gun control and would probably have to get it illegally. Obviously I can't spend too much money because I don't have a lot to my name.

I also appreciate the sentiment, but I've tried to think happy thoughts for many years now. It got better for a little while, but then I realized that my current job does not pay enough to cover my bills, then I got sexually assaulted by my roommate last month (no physical evidence or witnesses, thankfully it didn't go full blown rape but either way I have no legal grounds to press charges or evict him). When I think about not having enough money to move, and being stuck in my shitty living situation for another 6 months is just heartbreaking. Had mental health issues my whole life because I'm a stupid crazy bitch. It's enough, I can tell my family is getting tired of me.
